notes.title: Astronaut Assault Participating In Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Astronaut Assault is participating in this month's Steam Next Fest! The demo is available now with a tutorial and repeatable challenge mode, dive in and survive waves of enemy robots & aliens today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923327/7ea39b86c5d5fd82709c5a83042ea7f86952ee88.png[/img]

notes.title: Astronaut Assault to Participate In Toronto XP Game Summit June 13th & 14th
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Astronaut Assault will be featured in the upcoming Toronto XP Game Summit, starting on June 13th! This is a fantastic opportunity for gamers to explore our newly announced title, play the demo, and learn more about its upcoming release. 

If you will be in attendance of the XP Game Summit, lets connect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923327/e20c304bd089ce69f345232a83c454cb75cd044b.png[/img]

notes.title: Free Demo of Astronaut Assault Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Don't miss the chance to try the demo and experience the game's unique blend of tower defense, 3rd person action, and survival. We encourage you to share your feedback and reviews on Steam to help us improve the game.

[previewyoutube=kM_2U0bNHhU;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned for updates and make sure to add Astronaut Assault to your wishlist on Steam to keep track of the latest news and developments.
